result.instructions: Tools for Inzetrooster, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which shifts are still open this week?"; "Show every shift for the Ochtendploeg group in May 2026."; "Which groups have shifts next month, and how many does each have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Inzetrooster data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run inzetrooster_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inzetrooster_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inzetrooster_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. inzetrooster_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inzetrooster_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List shifts (diensten) of the Inzetrooster account, with group, location, time and the assigned person. Without filters the API returns the next 12 months of published shifts. Includes private groups and volunteer names. Set open_only to keep only shifts with no person assigned (applies to the returned page only). Inzetrooster API: GET /<account>/api/v1/shifts.

group_ids.description: Only these group ids. Use inzetrooster_list_groups to find ids.

date_to.description: Shifts up to this date, inclusive (yyyy-mm-dd). Works across a year boundary.

published.description: false also returns shifts that are not published yet (default: published only).

open_only.description: true keeps only shifts with no person assigned (client-side, this page only).

tools.name: inzetrooster_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the groups (ploegen) that have shifts in a date window, with the number of shifts per group. Derived from the shifts on the first page (up to 500 shifts): a group with no shifts in the window does not appear. Includes private groups. Use the ids with inzetrooster_list_shifts.

published.description: false also counts shifts that are not published yet.
